stem: Which products are on the Massachusetts pharmacist/pharmacy-intern administration list for treatment of mental illness or substance use disorder, assuming the remaining guidance conditions are met? Select all that apply.

explanation.core_reasoning: The MH/SUD pathway uses a defined list of LAI antipsychotics plus extended-release naltrexone rather than any injectable prescription product.

choice_analysis.A: Vivitrol is the listed SUD injectable.
choice_analysis.B: Insulin is not on the MH/SUD list.
choice_analysis.C: Testosterone has a separate statutory administration category, not this MH/SUD list.

related_facts: Other listed antipsychotics include haloperidol decanoate and risperidone long-acting injection.
explanation.mpje_trap: Selecting an injectable merely because pharmacists may administer it under some other law.

reasoning_steps: Match it to the official MH/SUD administration list
